explanation: I searched Mathlib for lemmas saying that the image of a p-adic integer in a characteristic-p field satisfies x^p = x. I looked at the Padics directory and at general `algebraMap ... ^ p` patterns. The only close candidates are `ZMod.pow_card` and `FiniteField.pow_card`, which are about `ZMod p` and finite fields. The library's proof already uses `ZMod.pow_card`, but only for the `ZMod p` part. Getting from `ZMod.pow_card` to the stated result also needs `PadicInt.ker_toZMod`, `PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p` and an ideal-membership argument. That is more than one or two short lines, so I found no single declaration that gives it.
